name: arahbo_two_cats_returned_together_make_two_cats
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever Arahbo or another nontoken Cat you control enters, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.' Support card: FDN Raise the Past (verified; 'Return all creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.'). Two Cat creature cards return to seat 0's battlefield at the same time: each is a Cat entering, so Arahbo triggers twice (once per Cat, not once for the event) and seat 0 gets two Cat tokens.
